entries.title: Grimring opens
items: Twelve fighters to pick from: goblins, skeletons, a zombie, an orc, an ogre, bandits, a cultist and a lizardfolk spear.
The Gauntlet: eight rounds against one or two foes at a time, with a boon to choose after every win.
Duel any fighter against one or two others, or sit back and watch two or three of them fight.
Every fighter has an attack, a special move and a dodge. Keyboard, touch and controller all work.
